parent_contract.binding: Only observed binding payload; temporary until exact PID and edition match actual validDevices
parent_contract.connectivity: ReceiverDevicesObservation retains known-positive PID/edition entries in complete or partial discovery; absent partial is unknown and absent complete is disconnected; duplicate owners remain ambiguous
parent_contract.retry: At most 30 delayed 1000ms requests while temporary and connected; pause outside active real-owner Customize page or while dialog owns query
parent_contract.success_close: 1000ms only after accepted actual Bind/Unbind result; new intent/session invalidates ticket
parent_contract.connection_event: Current 78548/Be -> 34340/kO=oe hardware-event producer is traced in receiver-connect-events-current-evidence.json; source SLAVE_CONNECT_EVENT has a 20000ms loading timer; no native publisher is integrated and query status=1 does not imply eventValue.state=3
parent_contract.skeleton: Source 80x16 SVG split into base/sweep; native 1500ms translation plus 500ms hold, reduced motion static
parent_contract.adaptation: Empty successful read clears binding; failed read is explicit. Navigation needs one actual device identity; missing edition/category are never invented
